title: Action execution state
description: Polling record written when a runner starts work that completes elsewhere. Published under the create routing key onto an exchange whose durable queue no shipped process consumes.

execution-id.description: The live action to come back to. Unique across the collection. Wire key: execution_id.

query-module.description: Name of the in-process module that knows how to ask whether the remote work finished. Not a queue and not a URL. Wire key: query_module.

query-context.description: Whatever that module needs in order to ask. The shape belongs to the module. Wire key: query_context.
